protocol: Two fresh isolated runs; expected identities frozen before pilot execution; no test changes

suites.basis: Existing local JUnit identities, checked against frozen source hash
tests: A SelectableSet should contain an element after insertion
A SelectableSet should not contain an element after removal
A SelectableSet should convert to a list containing the elements it contains
A SelectableSet should return an element uniformly at random when selecting
A SelectableSet should create a separate copy of itself when cloning
A SelectableSet should enumerate complete contents across capacity transitions

suites.basis: Existing local JUnit identities, checked against frozen source hash
tests: Gaussian block proposals should reject invalid dimensions, duplicates, nonfinite, asymmetric and non-positive-definite covariance
Gaussian block proposals should reject foreign, observed, intervened, inactive, invalid and subclassed targets
Gaussian block proposals should match an independent value-space Cholesky and log-density-ratio oracle with unequal prior scales
Gaussian block proposals should restore both randomness and values after early target-condition rejection
Gaussian block proposals should restore block targets and descendants after joint evidence rejection
Gaussian block proposals should recover conjugate moments without incorrectly cancelling the prior
Gaussian block proposals should recover correlated moments and reach precision
Gaussian block proposals should preserve exact worker-count and fixed/adaptive prefixes on a deterministic initialization fixture
Gaussian block proposals should allow state-independent mixtures so variables outside the block are not frozen
Gaussian block proposals should reject unsafe execution and clean up workers on callback failure
Gaussian block proposals should reject sequential continuation instead of silently changing joint-proposal semantics

suites.basis: Existing local JUnit identities, checked against frozen source hash
tests: Guided fixed-budget accounting should correct initialization and carry using the full proposal law
Guided fixed-budget accounting should correct ordinary and auxiliary selection including its normalizer for both methods
Guided fixed-budget accounting should skip look-ahead on carry and leave guided results unchanged
Guided fixed-budget accounting should preserve bootstrap replay with no guidance or neutral auxiliary sampling
Guided fixed-budget accounting should allow an auxiliary bootstrap step without child densities
Guided fixed-budget accounting should retain tiny parent log weights and restore them on carry
Guided fixed-budget accounting should produce constant corrected scalar Gaussian weights
Guided fixed-budget accounting should produce constant corrected multivariate Gaussian weights
Guided fixed-budget accounting should retain collapse diagnostics but invalidate failed density callbacks
Guided fixed-budget accounting should fail terminally for unsupported auxiliary scores and allow defended fallback
Guided fixed-budget accounting should reject density overflow, reentrancy and interruption without a partial posterior
Guided fixed-budget accounting should enforce owner access and lifecycle on the new methods

suites.basis: Existing local JUnit identities, checked against frozen source hash
tests: Fixed-budget bootstrap filtering should require an explicit valid population policy and method
Fixed-budget bootstrap filtering should use strict previous-population thresholds without equating fraction one with Always
Fixed-budget bootstrap filtering should carry normalized weights and use weighted evidence rather than an unweighted mean
Fixed-budget bootstrap filtering should match independent exact two-state expectations over every initial ancestor and transition outcome
Fixed-budget bootstrap filtering should select stratified ancestors using exact interval boundaries and never select zero mass
Fixed-budget bootstrap filtering should replay both methods and account for only one ancestor selection per step

suites.basis: Existing local JUnit identities, checked against frozen source hash
tests: Fixed-budget numerical and lifecycle contracts should retain tiny positive logs without declaring genuine collapse
Fixed-budget numerical and lifecycle contracts should retain the historical CDF diagnosis but resolve actual draws without a fallback
Fixed-budget numerical and lifecycle contracts should invalidate the public filter on an explicit stratified domain refusal
Fixed-budget numerical and lifecycle contracts should preserve tiny log weights when resampling is skipped
Fixed-budget numerical and lifecycle contracts should fail with a completed collapse report and forbid stale posterior or restart
Fixed-budget numerical and lifecycle contracts should handle absolute tiny or large likelihoods without ordinary-space overflow
Fixed-budget numerical and lifecycle contracts should reject invalid likelihoods, carried arithmetic overflow and cumulative overflow
Fixed-budget numerical and lifecycle contracts should invalidate on callback failure and reentrancy without publishing a partial step
Fixed-budget numerical and lifecycle contracts should honor interruption before and during a callback and leave the interrupt flag set
Fixed-budget numerical and lifecycle contracts should confine lifecycle access to the owner without damaging the owner's valid state
Fixed-budget numerical and lifecycle contracts should validate observable queries without changing the filter

suites.basis: Existing local JUnit identities, checked against frozen source hash
tests: Decision-focused stratification should preserve capacity without allocating unbounded decimal tables
Decision-focused stratification should select an entire maximum-size uniform population without redraws
Decision-focused stratification should resolve large sparse equal-support and nonuniform unambiguous decisions
Decision-focused stratification should check the log-span limit exactly rather than with rounded subtraction
Decision-focused stratification should resolve equal weights and exact ties on an exhaustive midpoint grid
Decision-focused stratification should exclude true zeros and preserve a zero coordinate
Decision-focused stratification should resolve dominant-weight and underflow populations without global CDF intervals
Decision-focused stratification should refine boundary-adjacent decisions and report exhausted budgets
Decision-focused stratification should keep exact equal-log symbolic ties distinct from approximate equality
Decision-focused stratification should refuse a genuinely unresolved comparison at the full precision limit
Decision-focused stratification should preserve offset invariance and finite-grid conditional offspring counts
Decision-focused stratification should consume exactly one random coordinate per stratum despite refinement
Decision-focused stratification should validate domain and interrupt without clearing the flag

suites.basis: Existing local JUnit identities, checked against frozen source hash
tests: Weighted bounded filtering should retain the entire initial batch and discard only an adaptive stopping candidate
Weighted bounded filtering should keep partial weighted populations when the hard cap is exhausted
Weighted bounded filtering should preserve absolute tiny and large likelihoods and retain tiny positive log weights
Weighted bounded filtering should validate likelihoods scores and work boundaries without accepting invalid results
Weighted bounded filtering should select weighted ancestors with strict boundaries and never a zero interval
Weighted bounded filtering should match exact two-step finite evidence and unnormalized state moments
Weighted bounded filtering should terminate on genuine zero weights and retain diagnostics without retry
Weighted bounded filtering should propagate callback failure interruption and reentrancy without partial estimates
Weighted bounded filtering should replay owned streams and reject access from another thread
Weighted bounded filtering should restore the ambient RNG even after a sampling callback fails
Weighted bounded filtering should exclude the stopping candidate from actual next-step ancestry
Weighted bounded filtering should warn about concentration even when every likelihood is positive
Weighted bounded filtering should preserve constant-weight evidence on long sequences
Weighted bounded filtering should match Kalman evidence and unnormalized moments across all predeclared seeds

suites.basis: Existing local JUnit identities, checked against frozen source hash
tests: Calibrated guided filtering should validate total work and probability preferences
Calibrated guided filtering should use disjoint fixed pilots and a frozen scale without changing weights
Calibrated guided filtering should choose the smallest conservative cap above the floor and include pilot cost
Calibrated guided filtering should retain production even when no scale or adequate adaptive cap is found
Calibrated guided filtering should keep pilot work diagnostics on genuine production collapse without retries
Calibrated guided filtering should restore ambient randomness and replay calibration plus production
Calibrated guided filtering should fail closed on pilot callbacks interruption and reentrant use
Calibrated guided filtering should reject invalid proposal densities and correction overflow
Calibrated guided filtering should apply initial and parent-conditional density corrections exactly once
Calibrated guided filtering should use the full defensive mixture density including both branches
Calibrated guided filtering should match Gaussian conditioning and preserve its constant corrected initial weight
Calibrated guided filtering should match exact finite guided stopping trees for evidence and state mass
Calibrated guided filtering should apply corrected scores and retain zero target mass without treating it as density failure
Calibrated guided filtering should clear calibration on manual steps and reject foreign-thread calibration
Calibrated guided filtering should bound Bernoulli score misses conservatively against exact enumeration
Calibrated guided filtering should cover bounded-score pilot means by exact binomial summation
Calibrated guided filtering should match Gaussian evidence and unnormalized moments with work-inclusive calibration

suites.basis: Existing local JUnit identities, checked against frozen source hash
tests: Auxiliary filtering should normalize full defensive ancestor probabilities and correct their complete law
Auxiliary filtering should preserve support for zero look-ahead scores and disclose an all-zero fallback
Auxiliary filtering should give constant corrected weights under exact Gaussian adaptation without losing evidence normalization
Auxiliary filtering should replay ordinary filtering exactly with a unit defensive share and no look-ahead calls
Auxiliary filtering should prepare once before calibration and account separately for pilots production and look-ahead
Auxiliary filtering should replay calibrated auxiliary steps and restore ambient randomness
Auxiliary filtering should invalidate after callback failure and preserve diagnostics only for genuine collapse
Auxiliary filtering should reject use before start foreign threads reentrancy and interrupted preparation
Auxiliary filtering should match exhaustive two-step evidence and unnormalized mass including bounded stopping
Gaussian observation helpers should handle multiple correlated observation coordinates and disparate physical scales
Gaussian observation helpers should match a rational rectangular-observation control and the joint density identity
Gaussian observation helpers should reduce to scalar conditioning and reject malformed singular or zero-noise inputs

suites.basis: Source-declared AnyWordSpec names (one top-level should scope)
tests: The explicit vector sampler should validate inputs and storage before calling the model
The explicit vector sampler should reject invalid densities and zero-support starts without masking callbacks
The explicit vector sampler should produce detached reproducible complete traces and discard exact warm-up counts
The explicit vector sampler should charge every callback and keep incomplete transitions out of capped traces
The explicit vector sampler should fail closed on search exhaustion and floating-point boundary collapse
The explicit vector sampler should preserve caller interruption before, during and after a callback
The explicit vector sampler should isolate simultaneous and nested runs without global RNG or worker ownership
The explicit vector sampler should allow another thread to cancel a cooperatively blocked density callback
The explicit vector sampler should match an independent planar angular implementation on nonradial targets
The explicit vector sampler should match independent inverse-CDF draws when the quantile target equals its reference
The explicit vector sampler should preserve independent Gaussian and constrained exponential target moments in 8 and 32 dimensions

suites.basis: Source-declared AnyWordSpec names (one top-level should scope)
tests: Multi-chain vector sampling should preserve exact coordinate summaries for odd, tied, constant and extreme traces across bounds
Multi-chain vector sampling should bound diagnostic scratch owners, restore coordinate order and join every worker
Multi-chain vector sampling should propagate diagnostic failure promptly and cancel and join siblings without partial output
Multi-chain vector sampling should cancel diagnostic workers on caller interruption and preserve its interrupt flag
Multi-chain vector sampling should honor pre-interruption for scalar diagnostics and serial coordinate dispatch
Multi-chain vector sampling should retain the primary diagnostic error when a sibling exceeds its shutdown budget
Multi-chain vector sampling should partition benchmark time without changing public output or seeded work
Multi-chain vector sampling should match individual kernels exactly across worker counts and assign seeds in index order
Multi-chain vector sampling should construct models serially and bound workers while retaining all chains
Multi-chain vector sampling should validate aggregate limits and all models before any density evaluation
Multi-chain vector sampling should retain capped chains and explicitly align diagnostics without discarding excess draws
Multi-chain vector sampling should detect a later chain failure promptly and join cooperatively cancelled siblings
Multi-chain vector sampling should preserve factory exceptions and factory or caller interruption
Multi-chain vector sampling should cancel a running pool on caller interruption and restore its flag after joining
Multi-chain vector sampling should report an uncooperative callback as a bounded shutdown failure without hiding the primary error
Multi-chain vector sampling should finish shutdown despite repeated caller interrupts without touching callback-owned resources
Multi-chain vector sampling should isolate nested runs and aggregate diagnostics without changing outer streams
Multi-chain vector sampling should propagate kernel search failures instead of fabricating constant-chain success
